correctness.rationale: Every binary occupied site fires and shifts one step, so the entire avalanche complex is a cyclic translation orbit of one 3-set. Difference cosets prove the exact component count. Arithmetic progressions reduce componentwise to filled triangles, tetrahedral boundaries, or a cycle after m free-edge collapses. For nonprogressions the three unoriented edge-difference classes are distinct, exactly one class may be antipodal, and n distinct triangles each possess a unique free edge; collapsing all n yields connected graphs with the stated edge and vertex counts. The graph ranks give all integral homotopy and homology conclusions. The standalone verifier checks 9,139 normalized supports, directly simulates 1,140 binary firing patterns, and independently computes 816 mod-two simplicial homologies. These finite tests corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: For nonadjacent, nonprogression supports the theorem computes every connected-component homotopy type and integral Betti rank, including arithmetic connected-component splitting and the antipodal half-turn transition. The source paper treats adjacent-pair three-chip supports in Proposition 3.34 and consecutive blocks in Theorem 3.32; those covered cases are explicitly acknowledged. Neither the inspected source sections nor the accessible indexed searches provide the complete general three-support result. The circular-arc theorem covers the progression-related nerve family but its homotopy classes (points, single odd spheres, wedges of even spheres) do not imply the generic higher-rank circle wedges. Unindexed equivalent work is a residual uncertainty.
residual_risks: No exhaustive search can exclude an unindexed earlier statement or an implicit consequence buried in a paper not found.
The 2014 arXiv paper was inspected in relevant extracted sections rather than every section; it is not claimed that all its text was searched line by line.
The elementary-collapse reasoning also has a direct combinatorial formulation unrelated to sandpiles, and such a formulation could have appeared in an unindexed source.

value.rationale: The source paper explicitly poses the decomposition of configuration space by avalanche homotopy type (Question 3.36) and only classifies selected three-chip patterns. This theorem completes the entire natural three-chip stratum for all directed-cycle lengths, gives exact free integral homology and component counts, and isolates a sharp antipodal change and an exceptional two-sphere geometry. Nonadjacent examples on 9-, 10-, and 12-cycles have distinct topologies not implied by the source adjacent-chip hypothesis; the result supplies an immediately reusable structural classification for the new graph-topology invariant.
